name: dondocs
description: Render SECNAV M-5216.5 naval correspondence to PDF or DOCX from a chat: every letter, memorandum, endorsement and agreement type, with a unit directory and letter templates.
long_description: DonDocs renders naval correspondence the way the manual prescribes: letterhead, seal, paragraph numbering, signature block, classification banners. The assistant supplies the content; the bundle writes a PDF or DOCX into the folder you choose. It runs entirely on this machine and reaches no network. DOCX output needs pandoc on PATH; PDF needs nothing else.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where rendered letters are written. Nothing is written anywhere else.

config_path.title: Machine defaults file
config_path.description: Optional companion.config.json with your unit, signer, SSIC and originator code, so they need not be given on every letter. Leave blank to use ~/.dondocs/companion.config.json if it exists.

tools.name: dondocs_letter
tools.description: Render a letter, memorandum, endorsement or agreement to PDF or DOCX

tools.name: dondocs_unit_lookup
tools.description: Find a unit's letterhead and mailing address in the bundled directory

tools.name: dondocs_template_get
tools.description: Fetch a template as a starting draft
